messages.subject: Bioc-teaching call Sep 19, 2-3pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

a quick reminder of the bioc-teaching call on Monday, September 19, 2-3pm CEST. We will summarize and discuss takeaways from the recent teaching week and Carpentries course, and plan how to move ahead.

The jitsi link is https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
